absent: Swap entry encoding, radix translation, and poisoned entry layout details beyond equality checks.
Initial lookup and allocation prologue of shared memory swapin before large entry splitting.
Definitions and tuning of huge page sizes, collapse thresholds, fault write modes, and zone ordering.
Implementations of file and anonymous collapse, promotion, policy resolution, readahead, and writeback helpers.
Stable and unstable tree algorithms and full same page merging scan lifecycle.
Global lock ordering and sleep ability rules across address space, folio, cluster, and scan locks.
Memory group charging failure handling and architecture specific swap restore effects.

findings.text: Direct collapse service processes a caller range by aligning boundaries to huge granularity, verifying eligibility, draining deferred work, iterating each huge unit through single unit handling, tracking fully collapsed units, revalidating the area after lock release, and reporting success only when every unit collapsed otherwise translating the last failure into caller errno.
Predicate reports whether the calling context is the huge page collapse daemon by comparing the current thread routine against the daemon routine.
Watermark refresh helper serializes with the daemon mutex and refreshes the recommended minimum free memory only while huge pages are enabled and the daemon thread exists.

Collapse failure translation maps allocation exhaustion to out of memory, group charge and sparse coverage to busy, transient page states such as count lock lru fill private dirty to retryable, and all other outcomes to invalid argument to guide caller fallback.

Daemon lifecycle sets freezable state and low priority, repeatedly performs a scan pass then waits for work or stop, and on termination detaches the current slot under the scan lock and releases it before exiting.

Scan pass drains deferred additions, iterates address spaces up to a configured page budget, tracks passes over the head of the queue, sleeps once on huge allocation failure and aborts on a second consecutive failure or stop request.
Daemon has work when the scan queue holds entries and huge pages are enabled, whereas the wait predicate wakes when the queue holds entries or a stop was requested regardless of enablement.
Daemon idle behavior sleeps for a configured interval when work exists and otherwise waits indefinitely while enabled, using deadline expiry or stop as wake conditions.

Slot scan advances a global cursor across virtual areas, aligns each eligible area to huge boundaries, collapses each huge aligned address in turn, releases the address space lock around file work and allocation, accounts progress per area and address, and retires the slot when the space exits or is fully scanned.

Single huge address collapse asserts address space lock, dispatches anonymous areas to anonymous scan and file areas to file scan after releasing the lock with a file reference held, retries once after synchronous writeback for direct requests encountering dirty state, and converts an already huge mapped result through a promotion attempt under a reacquired lock.

File scan walks the page cache over one huge range under read side protection, tallies present pages and radix values separately with distinct exceed limits, validates node affinity load lru membership and exclusive reference count, tolerates concurrent replacement by rechecking identity, and on success invokes file collapse while recording progress and trace outcome.

Shared memory swapin completes insertion of a swapped folio into the page cache after splitting oversized entries, aligning swap and index for large folios, validating identity freshness and content readiness, waiting for writeback, restoring architecture metadata, optionally replacing zone unsuitable folios, updating inode accounting, and marking for access or dirty handling before publishing to the caller.

Swapin treats identity mismatch or stale cache content as an existence race requiring retry, treats missing up to date state as input output failure with poisoned entry installation, and rechecks cache freshness on failure paths to downgrade races correctly while releasing references and devices on all exits.

Swap confirmation performs a read side protected radix lookup at the given index and returns the entry order when the stored value equals the expected swap encoding, otherwise a negative sentinel indicating absence or mismatch with retry handling.
Cluster swapin resolves the memory policy for the fault index and issues a readahead request for neighboring swap content, releasing the policy reference before returning the resulting folio.

Swap allocation forces single page order when user fault handling is armed or compressed swap has been used, otherwise attempts the requested order under the resolved policy and on error retries once at order zero before returning the outcome.
Replacement need is decided solely by comparing the folio zone number against the allocation zone, indicating unsuitability when the resident zone is higher.

Folio replacement for constrained allocations drops constraint flags, narrows masks for large pages under transparent huge support, allocates and copies content into a new folio, transfers swap identity and cache membership with group and statistics updates under cluster lock, places the new folio on reclaim lists, and drops the old folio cache state and references.

Swapin error marking atomically exchanges the expected swap encoding for a poisoned encoding, and only on success waits for writeback, detaches swap state, and subtracts both allocated and swapped accounting so release does not warn.

Large entry split restricts allocation flags to reclaim, verifies the stored value still matches the expected swap encoding, iteratively reduces entry order using minimal split steps, rewrites each sub range with contiguous swap offsets derived from alignment differences, and propagates allocation or mismatch errors.

Swapin holds the folio lock across identity confirmation readiness checks writeback wait metadata restore replacement and cache insertion, releasing on all paths, while holding a swap device reference across the whole operation.

Confirmation and file scan use read side critical sections with retry loops around radix traversal, acquiring extra folio references only after value checks and revalidating identity after acquisition.

Large entry splitting uses interrupt disabling radix transaction locking around load validation and order mutation, unlocking before handling allocation shortage and retrying until memory is available or a terminal error occurs.

Collapse paths require address space read lock on entry, drop it around file cache scan writeback and allocation with explicit dropped flags, reacquire for promotion and validation, use try lock when scanning slots to skip contended spaces, and serialize slot selection with a dedicated spin lock.
Folio replacement serializes swap cache exchange with interrupt disabling cluster locking, and watermark update serializes with daemon mutex guard.
Millimeter slot extension for same page merging holds a base slot plus a head pointer to reverse mapping items belonging to that address space.

Scanner cursor records the current slot being scanned, the address offset within it, the address of the reverse mapping list pointer for iteration, and a sequence number for unstable tree generations.

Stable node can act either as a tree node or as a migration list element with head plus duplicate and list linkage, carries a hash chain of sharing entries, alternates between frame number and prune time storage, tracks sharing list length with a distinguished chain sentinel, and records node affinity when NUMA is present.

Reverse mapping item links siblings, alternates between reverse mapping structure and node identifier, points to owning address space, stores address with flag bits, alternates between unstable checksum plus aging counters and stable linear index, and alternates between unstable tree node and stable head plus hash linkage.
Sequence mask value is 0x0ff preserving low eight bits of unstable generation, unstable flag value is 0x100 marking unstable tree membership, stable flag value is 0x200 marking stable tree listing.
Chain sentinel value is negative 1024 marking chained stable nodes, chosen distinct from negative one to allow reliable underflow detection.
NUMA annotation evaluates to its argument with execution when NUMA support is present and to zero with empty execution otherwise, selected by alternate definitions.
Reverse mapping age counter is an unsigned byte type used for scan aging and skip accounting.
Trace point creation marker enables same page merging trace definitions at this compilation unit.

File collapse scan treats concurrent cache replacement, failed reference acquisition, node abort, non lru membership, unexpected reference count, and excessive missing or swapped coverage as distinct abort reasons with accounting events, avoiding promotion of unstable or shared content.

Slot iteration checks for exiting spaces and disabled huge pages before and during traversal, uses non blocking lock acquisition to avoid stalls, and ensures exiting spaces detach their slots so teardown does not reference freed state.
